title: ViralClip AI v1.8.22 - Ultra-Clean Bicubic Scaling & CRF 18
changelog: Switched from Lanczos to Bicubic scaling to eliminate ringing halos and jagged edges
Upgraded encoder from superfast to veryfast with CRF 18 for pristine macroblock-free skin tones
Added explicit BT.709 color primaries and transfer characteristics for natural color rendering
